title: Lonely Pixel II
goal: Solve Lonely Pixel II: Find black pixels with exactly N black pixels in both their row and column.
strategy: Find black pixels with exactly N black pixels in both their row and column.
edgeCases: Row and column black counts alone are insufficient; the required rows sharing a candidate column must also have identical patterns.
inputRules: picture must be a non-empty 2D array, e.g. [["W","B"],["B","W"]]
every picture row must have the same length
picture cells must be strings like "B" or "W"
N must be a non-negative number
